annotations.title: Know Your Payee: should the agent pay this payee? (paid)

description: Use right before an agent pays a payee it has not paid before: the reverse of the know-your-agent checks merchants run on agents. Send url (webshop or x402 endpoint), wallet (x402 payTo) or iban with name and country (a company); kind=shop|x402|company forces the route. Input: url, wallet or iban + name + country. Costs 0.03 USDC via x402, or 15 credits of a Factline API key. The first 5 paid-tool calls a day are free, no payment or key needed.
